Maya (Eng PM): Quick follow-up from todays all-hands runtime segment. Can runtime + SRE drop a short checklist for next steps on kernels, batching, and cache?

Diego (Runtime): TL;DR: 1) kernel splits: low-latency vs high-throughput; 2) adaptive batching prototype this sprint; 3) KV policy per-tenant beta in 2 sprints.

Priya (SRE): For canaries: need a reproducible profile for long-seq chat that caused tail spikes. Can you publish the harness?

Diego (Runtime): Will push the long-seq canary config to infra/perf tonight (seq=1024, microbatch=4, prewarm=false).

Sam (Backend): Hosted: will KV policy be exposed as a feature flag per-customer? We need that to coordinate partner tests.

Diego (Runtime): Yes. Hosted will have a feature flag; Dedicated/Private get tenant config. Default = conservative LRU + keep-alive bias.

Maya (Eng PM): Any safety nets if someone flips aggressive eviction and sessions break?

Priya (SRE): Well add auto-detect: if session churn > 5% in 5m, kill aggressive mode and notify oncall. Also a manual rollback toggle. Ill draft runbook.

Ava (VP Eng): If GPU slots block canaries, escalate here. We should prioritize these perf runs.

Diego (Runtime): Noted. Possible blocker: multiple parallel seq=1024 runs might saturate our test quota. Will coordinate with Priya.

Maya (Eng PM): Action items: Diego publish perf + canary config (ETA tonight); Priya add runbook + auto-disable guard (ETA tomorrow AM); Sam wire feature-flag gating for Hosted (ETA 2 sprints). Post updates here when done.

Diego (Runtime): Will do. Keeping replies short  deep dives in eng-runtime.

Priya (SRE): Got it.

Sam (Backend): Roger.
